guide.summary: GitLab documents OAuth applications registered in the user's account, with scopes limiting resource access. The supplied sources document read_api for read access to the API, including projects, and the project issues list endpoint with keyset pagination. Individual customer account connection is supported by the OAuth flow. Provider review, customer administrator approval and marketplace requirements are not documented in the supplied sources and remain unknowns.
guide.recommendation: The requested API test is not ready yet. Resolve the access mapping for Read issue titles in projects the connected person can access, with pagination. Use “Find missing request” or add official documentation beside that action.

steps.title: Register an OAuth application in the test account
steps.detail: Open user settings applications in the representative developer test account and add a new application with a name and redirect URI. Select read_api as the only scope.
steps.doneWhen: Application ID is shown after saving.

steps.detail: Send the test account to the authorize URL with the client ID, redirect URI, state and scope read_api, then approve the request. Setup only, not a resource action.
steps.doneWhen: The redirect returns an authorization code and the state matches.

steps.title: Exchange the authorization code for an access token
steps.detail: Use the returned authorization code and the application credentials at the token endpoint to obtain an OAuth access token for the test account. The token is used as a Bearer token.
steps.doneWhen: An access token and its expiry are returned for the test account.

steps.title: Read issue titles from one project with the OAuth token
steps.detail: Call the project issues list for one project the test account can access and confirm the issue title values in the response. Boundary check: confirm the token scope is read_api and that only GET requests were sent; do not create, update or delete any issue.
steps.doneWhen: Issue titles are read from the first page of one accessible project and no write request was sent.
